recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast monochrome portrait of two figures at the bottom, overlaid with large, expressive hand-drawn lettering in blue with red offset outlines on a neutral, slightly aged background.
coreVisualRelationships: Text dominates the upper two-thirds of the frame
Subjects are anchored to the bottom edge
Red outlines are consistently offset to the bottom-right of blue strokes
Thin red arrows create a horizontal bridge between the subjects and the subtitle
coreInvariants: Blue marker-style fill for primary text
Thin red line-work for outlines and arrows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two male figures positioned at the bottom, cropped at the chest, occupying roughly 35% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large blue lettering in the top center serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large top text, move down to the subtitle flanked by arrows, and settle on the facial expressions of the subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample breathing room around the central text and between the text and the subjects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cream/Off-white background provides a neutral canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black for photographic subjects creates a grounded base.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant blue and bright red for the graphic elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the primary colors contrasts with the desaturated, high-value background and low-value subjects.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to 4 primary tones: Cream, Black, Blue, Red

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Casual, slanted sans-serif with varying stroke widths.
letterConstructionRules: Strokes mimic a broad-nib felt marker
Visible texture within the blue fill suggesting manual application
Red outlines are thin, sketchy, and intentionally misaligned/offset
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'a' with a rounded bowl and short tail
Ascenders and descenders are kept short to maintain a compact block
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A smaller, thinner version of the same hand-drawn style for secondary text, paired with simple geometric arrows.
graphicDevices: Horizontal arrows pointing in opposite directions

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the casual, thick-stroke aesthetic of the primary text.
Necessary to achieve the specific 'misprinted' red outline effect.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photograph of two men in 1970s attire (striped rugby shirt and a vest) against a plain cream background, positioned at the bottom of the frame with significant empty space above them.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of large, hand-drawn blue marker text in the upper space. Offset a thin red outline 2 pixels down and to the right. Below the main text, add a smaller line of blue text flanked by two thin red arrows pointing outwards.

verificationChecks: Is the red outline offset from the blue fill?
Is the background a warm cream rather than pure white?
Does the text have a visible marker-drawn texture?

adjustableVariables: Degree of offset for the red outline
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects
Any brand logos or small corner text
Exact handwriting of the original artist

mustAchieve: Strong contrast between graphic elements and photography

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red arrows are thin and hand-drawn
Check that the blue text is the most saturated element
Verify the subjects are cropped at the bottom edge
Confirm the text is centered horizontally
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast B&W photo base + Cream paper texture + Textured marker display type + Offset color-stroke overlay.
